name: Two Halves Become One
summary: Janice Felstone needs you to find and mend the missing half of a Good Luck Charm on Felstone Farm. She is waiting for the charm in the Western Plaguelands.

sections.title: A Broken Charm
sections.body: The charm's other half lies somewhere on Felstone Farm in the Western Plaguelands. You are asked to find it and join the two pieces. Then Janice Felstone can receive the mended charm.

faq.answer: Janice Felstone needs you to find the other half of the Good Luck Charm on Felstone Farm, reassemble it, and give it to her.

faq.q: Where is the other half of the charm?
faq.answer: The other half of the Good Luck Charm is somewhere on Felstone Farm in the Western Plaguelands.

faq.q: What do I do with the two charm pieces?
faq.answer: Reassemble the Good Luck Charm and give it to Janice Felstone on Felstone Farm.

attribution: In-game quest text: Two Halves Become One
